text.content:
City Hall, the courts, and the Mayor's whole political future.

Region: Heywood (district K). Was: the Glen and the Reclamation Zone
Controlled by: The NCPD from Precinct 1, its headquarters: the best-policed district outside Corporate Plaza
The feel of it: A center scrubbed for the cameras, and edges that are another story
Notable locations: City Hall, the Hall of Justice (#30), 1st Night City Bank (#31), El Coyote Cojo (#32), Embers (#33), Time Machine (#34), Club Atlantis (#68), NCPD Precinct 1 (#69), World Stock Exchange (#70), Lazarus Regional HQ (#71)
Danger: Corporate / Moderate. SC 8 (NCPD, Hardened Medium). UC 3

Council staffers, lawyers, bankers and civil servants live in the center, working families in H3 and H4, and in the south the Reclamation Zone's people, where the Purge's detention camps stood and some families never left. The Valentinos run those blocks with more care than the Council does, and they and the NCPD have an understanding: no shootings near the courthouse.

Places

  • City Hall. SC 10. The Council chamber, the Mayor's office and a public gallery. Arasaka's Accord Liaison chair sits at the end of the Council table.
  • Hall of Justice (#30). SC 9. Courts, records and the prosecutor. Everything sealed in 2049 is in its basement.
  • 1st Night City Bank (#31). SC 10. Safe deposit boxes with a five-year waiting list.
  • Embers (#33). SC 8. Real fire grills. Council members eat here, and so do the people who own them.
  • Time Machine (#34). SC 6. Antiques and vintage tech: old Holophones, pre-war shards, guitars.
  • Club Atlantis (#68). SC 7. Sharks in the tanks, dirty money in the bathrooms.
  • World Stock Exchange (#70). SC 10. The Free City's own exchange since the Accord.

Getting There

NCART: Glen North, City Hall, Glen South (Central Loop, Southern Line).

Turf

Valentinos, in the old Reclamation Zone blocks.

People

  • Mayor Lucius Rhyne (Exec 8).
  • Commissioner Ramos (Solo 7, NCPD).
  • Rosa Delgado (Fixer 6). Owner of El Coyote Cojo.
  • Councilwoman Iris Marchetti (Exec 6). Represents Downtown.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.10
